name: godmode
description: Local-first context continuity and evidence-governance skills for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Local continuity and guarded coding workflows.
interface.longDescription: Godmode reconstructs repository reality from local evidence, preserves private continuity, diagnoses failures without looping, previews protected actions, and can forge validated project skills when a reusable gap is proven.
defaultPrompt: Resume this repository from verified local context.
Diagnose this failure without repeating failed hypotheses.
Preview this protected action and its recovery path.
